title: UNIT 5 – BEFORE YOU READ – READ – COMPREHENSION
rawTitle: UNIT 5 – BEFORE YOU READ – READ – COMPREHENSION

items.scene: Animals make their homes in many places. Where are some animal homes? High in a tree is a big eagle's nest. There, eagles keep their chicks safe. Some eagles are white and brown. They eat rabbits, lizards, frogs, birds, and even small dogs! An opossum lives inside a tree hollow. It lines it with leaves and grass. Inside, it stays safe and dry. Opossums are gray or black. Mother opossums carry their babies on their backs. Honeybees make a hive for their home. They make honey in the hive. The bees have food all winter long. Honeybees have five eyes. Honeybees can't see the color red. Some crabs make their homes in old seashells. They find new seashells as they get big. Crabs live under water and on land. They have ten legs. An animal's home is the best place for it to live. Where is your home? How is your home right for you?

items.storyText: Animals make their homes in many places. Where are some animal homes? High in a tree is a big eagle's nest. There, eagles keep their chicks safe. Some eagles are white and brown. They eat rabbits, lizards, frogs, birds, and even small dogs! An opossum lives inside a tree hollow. It lines it with leaves and grass. Inside, it stays safe and dry. Opossums are gray or black. Mother opossums carry their babies on their backs. Honeybees make a hive for their home. They make honey in the hive. The bees have food all winter long. Honeybees have five eyes. Honeybees can't see the color red. Some crabs make their homes in old seashells. They find new seashells as they get big. Crabs live under water and on land. They have ten legs. An animal's home is the best place for it to live. Where is your home? How is your home right for you?
